summary: Phase 3 (Packages, Checkout, Stripe webhook, Filament, verified-ambassador redirect) fully verified. Ran the 19 phase-3 feature tests (CheckoutFlowTest + StripeWebhookTest) — 19/19 PASS with 56 assertions. Executed E2E against the preview URL: packages catalog, details form + validation, review page, pay button gracefully failing (Stripe unset), empty-session /review redirect, cancel page, admin login page render, and verified-ambassador /email/verify -> /ambassador/dashboard redirect. All checks passed.

coverage: details renders for active package, 404 for inactive slug
details persists to session and redirects to review
review redirects to details on empty session
pay returns error when Stripe unconfigured (Purchase still created)
pay attaches first-touch attribution (referral_code_snapshot, attribution_id, ambassador_profile_id_snapshot) from aior_ref cookie
webhook stores event and dispatches ProcessStripeEventJob for valid signature
webhook is idempotent for duplicate event ids
StripeEventProcessor marks purchase paid on checkout.session.completed and is idempotent on re-process
StripeEventProcessor flags ambassador (flagged_for_review=true) and marks Purchase 'chargeback' on charge.dispute.created

e2e_results.GET /packages: PASS — three packages IPTV 12 Months £60.00, IPTV + VPN 12 Months £85.00, VPN Only 12 Months £35.00 each linked to /checkout/{slug}/details.
e2e_results./checkout/iptv-12-months/details: PASS — all data-testid fields present: chk-name, chk-email, chk-username, chk-delivery, chk-phone, chk-telegram, chk-terms, chk-privacy, chk-submit.
e2e_results.empty submit validation: PASS — stays on details URL, validation shown.
e2e_results.invalid username validation: PASS — 'Only letters, numbers, underscore and hyphen are allowed.' rendered.
e2e_results.delivery=whatsapp without phone: PASS — 'A WhatsApp/mobile number is required for WhatsApp delivery.' rendered.
e2e_results.valid submit -> /review: PASS — review shows IPTV 12 Months, £60.00, buyer_test_1 and data-testid=review-pay.
e2e_results.pay (Stripe unset) -> back to /details w: PASS — 'Stripe is not configured on this environment.' shown; test #10 in feature-suite confirms pending Purchase row is still persisted.
e2e_results./checkout/cancel?purchase=abc123: PASS — 'Payment was not completed' rendered. 'Try again' button intentionally only renders when purchase ID resolves to a real Purchase (controller: Purchase::find($id)); the fake ID used in E2E returns null so no button — this is correct behaviour, and the feature test `cancel page renders` covers the resolved case.
e2e_results./admin/login: PASS — Filament login page renders 200 with email input visible.
e2e_results.verified ambassador /email/verify -> /am: PASS — after logging in as preview-verified@example.com, visiting /email/verify final URL = /ambassador/dashboard (302 redirect confirmed).

issues: Terms/Privacy checkboxes lose their checked state after a server-side validation redirect back — Blade's old() isn't re-checking them. Minor UX friction: users must re-tick both boxes to re-submit. Consider `@checked(old('terms'))`.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Preserve terms/privacy checkbox state after validation errors on /checkout/{slug}/details using @checked(old('terms')) / @checked(old('privacy')).
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutController::cancel() renders 'Try again' only when Purchase::find($id) resolves. Fine, but the view silently omits the CTA when purchase is null — consider a fallback link back to /packages for direct/no-param visitors.
Stripe webhook (StripeWebhookController) correctly rejects missing signature (400), persists stripe_events, and dispatches ProcessStripeEventJob idempotently — implementation looks solid.

PackagesSeeder currently hardcodes the three packages; consider making inserts idempotent by slug (updateOrInsert) so re-seeding in preview is safe (already appears to be the case based on 45+19 = 64 passing tests over multiple iterations).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all E2E checks pass; 1 minor UX note on checkbox persistence)

test_credentials: preview-verified@example.com / previewpass1234 (verified ambassador, code PREVIEW1). preview-admin@example.com / AdminPass1234! (Filament — login page confirmed 200; TOTP enrolment not driven).
seed_data_creation: None (relied on existing PackagesSeeder + PreviewAmbassadorSeeder). E2E buyer form submission created a pending Purchase row for iptv-12-months with buyer_test_1 / buyertest@example.com in the preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 is green end-to-end on preview. When re-running E2E, remember: (1) terms/privacy checkboxes must be re-ticked on each attempt after any validation redirect; (2) 'Try again' on /checkout/cancel only appears when ?purchase={real_ulid} — use a real Purchase ID from the DB if you want to verify the CTA. Stripe is intentionally unset — do not attempt real Stripe calls.
